column1: # CLAIMS.tsv — every checkable assertion this project's docs are allowed to make.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# On 2026-08-17 an audit found four separate documents asserting that golden
# tests were a universal acceptance gate. Zero golden tests existed. The same
# audit found BUILD_STATE.json claiming Firebase was deferred (it was fully
# wired), four built screens marked pending, and i18n reported as "262 keys /
# 21 translated" when the real numbers were 971 / 495. Each false claim had
# steered real work in the wrong direction for weeks.
# THE RULE
# A doc may only assert something that has a row here, and a row is only true
# when its command says so. doc_truth_guard.sh runs every command every wake.
# Adding a claim to a doc without adding a row here is itself a gate failure.
# FORMAT (tab-separated, 4 columns)
#   claim_id <TAB> assertion <TAB> verify_command <TAB> expected
# expected: ==N | >=N | <=N   (the command must print a single integer)
# Commands run with cwd = the Flutter app root.
# STATUS AT CREATION: 8 of 10 rows are RED. That is the correct honest starting
# state, and Band B0 is literally "turn every red row green". The 2 green rows
# are locks on things that are already true and must not regress.
golden_gate_exists
column2: Golden tests are a universal acceptance gate
